content.value: Make sentence with the following structures using the words given in brackets.
i. Subj. + Linking verb + Adj. Complement. (Appear as verb)
ii. Subj. + Intransitive verb + Adv. of Manner. (Study as verb)
iii. Subj. + Transitive verb + Object. (Read as verb)
iv. That + Subj. + Verb + Adv. of Manner + Verb + Adj. Complement. (Speak and is as verb)
v. Since + Subj. + Verb + Adj. Complement, Subj + Verb + Adv. of place. (is and prosper as verb)
vi. Subj. + Verb + Adv. of Manner, but + Verb + Adj. Complement. (Labor and is as verb)
vii. Subj. + Relative pronoun + Verb + Adv. of place, + Verb + Noun Complement. (Live and is as verb)
